chunks: Touching the Black Stone. Then touch the Black Stone and kiss it in every circuit. If you are not able to do so, then begin with it and end with it. If you are not able to do so, then wipe it with your right hand and kiss it. If you are not able to do so, then point toward it with your hand and kiss it.

And say: “I have fulfilled my trust and upheld my covenant, so that it may testify for me to faithful completion. I have believed in Allah and disbelieved in al-jibt, al-taghut, al-Lat, al-'Uzza, the worship of Shaytan, the worship of idols, and the worship of every rival called upon besides Allah, Mighty and Majestic.”

key_terms.أَمَانَتِي: my trust, meaning the entrusted commitment being fulfilled
key_terms.بِيَدِكَ ٱلْيُمْنَى: with your right hand, as the prescribed manner when possible
key_terms.مِيثَاقِي: my covenant, the solemn pledge being upheld
key_terms.نِدٍّ: a rival or counterpart set up alongside Allah in worship
key_terms.ٱلطَّاغُوتِ: rebellious false authority or object of worship besides Allah
key_terms.ٱلْجِبْتِ: false objects or systems of misguidance that are rejected
key_terms.ٱلْحَجَرِ ٱلْأَسْوَدِ: the Black Stone of the Ka'bah, approached during tawaf

ai.seo_question: How should one perform istilam of the Black Stone during tawaf if direct contact is not possible?
ai.summary: This passage describes the etiquette of istilam of the Black Stone during tawaf, giving graded alternatives based on one’s ability: kissing it directly, aligning the beginning and ending of the circuit with it, touching it by hand, or gesturing toward it. It also includes a supplication affirming fulfillment of one’s covenant and disavowal of false deities and all worship besides Allah.
